instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: crafting doesn't belong in every game.

Far Cry 3 made you hunt animals to craft wallets. Skinning a shark for pocket space is silly. The Tomb Raider reboot had Lara collecting salvage when she should have been raiding tombs. Crafting belongs in Minecraft, where it is the game. Everywhere else it is filler. Agree?
